info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Party Asset Directory Validation-spec
info.description: The Party Asset Directory Validation API is designed to facilitate the validation of asset directory entries linked to parties in a banking context. It allows users to submit validation requests for specific party asset directories, ensuring compliance and accuracy of asset information. This endpoint is primarily intended for use by financial institutions and regulatory bodies that require verification of asset data. Typical use cases include auditing, risk management, and regulatory reporting, enhancing the reliability of collateral information.

post.description: This endpoint is used to validate the asset directory associated with a specific party, ensuring that all necessary data is accurate and complete.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate validation for party asset directory operations. It requires the specific details related to the party and their assets to perform the necessary validations.
